packet.title: Decimal arithmetic with libmpdec (implementation)
packet.summary: Vendors mpdecimal 4.0 with the scoped allocator patch and implements internal decimal arithmetic: parse, canonical text, arithmetic, compare, round and conversions to and from int64_t and double.

body.p: After . Owns third_party/mpdecimal/, third_party/mpdecimal.version, src/decimal.c, src/decimal_internal.h, tests/decimal_test.c. Vendor mpdecimal 4.0.x, patched as , in Phase 1 (). Internal API: parse, canonical text, arithmetic incl. idiv and mod, compare, round, to and from int64_t and double. Done when two heaps on two threads work and the wasm size growth is logged. Spec: F&O 4.0 "Arithmetic operators on numeric values" (decimal precision), . Done 2026-10-16 (): two heaps on two threads tested; wasm growth +89 KB stripped (+35 KB gzip), logged.
